read_from: photo 0 front panel: Konica Minolta logo
photo 0 front lower left: bizhub PRO C754e

claims.claim: Konica Minolta Bizhub Pro C754e full colour laser multifunction printer
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the Konica Minolta logo and 'bizhub PRO C754e' on the front.
No photo of the counter or meter report; screen is off in photo 0.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted
claims.evidence: No photo of the drum units, toner cartridges or the consumables life screen.
No clip of the machine copying or printing a run of pages.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or may show service errors (fuser, transfer belt, mainboard)
risks.proof: Clip of the machine powering on to the home screen with no error, then copying a colour page

risks.risk: Total page count may be far higher than claimed, meaning worn fuser, belt and rollers
risks.proof: Photo of the printed counter list or the counter screen showing total, colour and black counts

risks.risk: Drums and toners may be worn or nearly empty rather than new
risks.proof: Screenshot of the consumables life screen showing drum and toner levels for all four colours
risks.if_unproven: as needing new drums and toners

risks.risk: Missing internal parts or options (fuser, transfer belt, hard disk, finisher, power cord)
risks.proof: Photos with the front doors open showing the toner and drum bays and the fuser area

proof_requests: Clip of the machine powering on and printing a colour test page or copying a colour document
Photo of the counter screen or printed counter list
Screenshot of the consumables and drum life screen
Photos with the front doors open
response.reason: The brand and model are readable on the front of the machine in photo 0, so it can be priced as a used bizhub PRO C754e at its worst case, not working and with a high page count. The page count, new drum and toner and no-jam claims are unproven and add nothing until shown.
